inputs.proposal: Review: coalesced signal updates with LiveView Page v0.3.0 phase 2
inputs.original_proposal: Review: coalesced signal updates with LiveView Page v0.3.0 phase 2

blockers: claim: Thread safety violation: m_currentFrameCount is accessed from multiple threads without synchronization. The worker thread in onFrame reads this value, and frameCount() can be called from any thread.; file: app/qttunebridge.h; quote: int frameCount() const { return m_currentFrameCount; }

claim: Thread safety violation: m_currentFrameCount is incremented in handleFrameInternal without atomic operations, creating a data race with the read in onFrame.; file: app/qttunebridge.cpp; quote: ++m_currentFrameCount;

claim: Logic bug: Drop threshold changed from MaxInFlightFrames (1000) to MaxFrames (10000), making the backpressure 10x more restrictive. Old code tracked queued-but-not-processed frames; new code tracks total processed frames which grows unboundedly.; file: app/qttunebridge.cpp; quote: if (self->m_currentFrameCount >= FrameListModel::MaxFrames) {
questions: What is the intended semantics of the drop mechanism? The old code dropped frames when the event queue was too deep; the new code drops frames when total processed count exceeds a threshold, but the model evicts old frames so new ones should always be accepted.
Why was the SignalListModel and signal batching functionality removed? This removes the core signal decoding capability from the application.
Should the forceFrameCountForTesting helper be restored for testing edge cases around the frame limit?

claim: Incorrect destruction order comment: The comment claims session close happens before model teardown, but models are created as QObject children and are destroyed before the destructor body runs.; file: app/qttunebridge.h; quote: qttune_session_t* m_session = nullptr;   // closed in dtor BEFORE model teardown
nits: Consider adding a comment explaining why m_currentFrameCount is not atomic (if intentional - e.g., only accessed from GUI thread).
The TabButton simplification in Main.qml removes theming - consider if this is intentional.
The removed test cases were testing important edge cases that should be verified.
